snippet.title: Core Hustlers Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3810800/Core_Hustlers/
Core Hustlers is a single-player sci-fi extraction shooter where every run is unique. Infiltrate derelict stations, hack data cores, outthink ruthless AI, and survive shifting, deadly environments.

Follow us
• Website: https://www.corehustlers.com
• X/Twitter: https://x.com/corehustlerone
• Discord: https://discord.gg/pbsts5CCYp

About the game
Single-player, Unreal Engine 5, procedural ships, high-tension combat, hacking/data-cores, and a cinematic narrative. Built by Cormorant Games, Davao City, Philippines.

Press / business
